entries.translation: --As provações de Gilead, Volume III

entries.source: The door has two latches locking it in place.
entries.translation: Há duas travas mantendo a porta fechada.

entries.source: There must be a way to open the temple door.
entries.translation: Deve haver uma maneira de abrir a porta do templo.

entries.source: There must be a way to open this door.
entries.translation: Deve haver uma maneira de abrir esta porta.

entries.source: I was hoping you'd show up; I want to make you scream.
entries.translation: Eu esperava que você aparecesse; quero ouvir você gritar.

entries.source: Unless you want to end up like Larson, get out of my way.
entries.translation: Se não quiser acabar como Larson, saia da minha frente.

entries.source: It's so good, isn't it?  It gets even better.
entries.translation: É bom demais, não é? E fica ainda melhor.

entries.source: You can't explain it to people; they have to feel it.
entries.translation: Não dá para explicar às pessoas; elas precisam sentir.

entries.source: Girl, you gotta be out of your mind!
entries.translation: Garota, você só pode estar maluca!

entries.source: Magnificent.
entries.translation: Magnífico.

entries.source: The obelisks don't appear to be securely fixed to the ground.
entries.translation: Os obeliscos parecem não estar firmemente presos ao chão.

entries.source: The valves need a special tool to turn them.
entries.translation: É preciso uma ferramenta especial para girar as válvulas.

entries.source: It looks like some of the architecture would support me.
entries.translation: Parece que parte da estrutura pode me sustentar.

entries.source: "But the new pharaoh was not content with all that was now his.
entries.translation: "Mas o novo faraó não se contentava com tudo o que agora possuía.

entries.source: No, Ramses the second wanted even more; he had visions of an empire
entries.translation: Não, Ramsés Segundo queria ainda mais; ele sonhava com um império

entries.source: so spectacular all mankind would come to marvel at its glory."
entries.translation: tão grandioso que toda a humanidade admiraria sua glória."

entries.source: This is merely an antechamber.
entries.translation: Isto é apenas uma antecâmara.

entries.source: The creature seems to mimic my every movement.
entries.translation: A criatura parece imitar cada movimento meu.

entries.source: The books may contain some useful information.
entries.translation: Os livros podem conter informações úteis.

entries.source: Now, I'm getting somewhere.
entries.translation: Agora estou chegando a algum lugar.

entries.source: Some things in here look light enough to move.
entries.translation: Algumas coisas aqui parecem leves o bastante para serem movidas.

entries.source: Sorry, darlin'.  This is the end of the line.
entries.translation: Foi mal, querida. Aqui termina a linha.

entries.source: Just hand it over, Larson.  This has nothing to do with you.
entries.translation: É só me entregar isso, Larson. Você não tem nada a ver com isso.

entries.source: What's it got to do with you?  This Scion belongs to Natla;
entries.translation: O que isso tem a ver com você? Este Scion pertence à Natla;

entries.source: Face it, you got no business here.
entries.translation: admita, você não tem nada que fazer aqui.

entries.source: I don't have time for this.  Get out of the way or you die.
entries.translation: Não tenho tempo para isso. Saia da frente ou morra.

entries.source: What you gonna do, shoot me?  C'mon, Lara; I just work here.
entries.translation: O que vai fazer, atirar em mim? Vamos, Lara; eu só trabalho aqui.

entries.source: Now I know how bad you want this, but I can't let you pass.
entries.translation: Agora sei o quanto você quer isso, mas não posso deixar você passar.

entries.source: And we both know you're not gonna kill me for it.
entries.translation: E nós dois sabemos que você não vai me matar por causa disso.

entries.source: That's just not who you are.
entries.translation: Você não é assim.

entries.source: I'm not who you think I am.
entries.translation: Eu não sou quem você pensa.

entries.source: There must be switches somewhere that open the gates.
entries.translation: Deve haver alavancas em algum lugar que abram os portões.

entries.source: It looks as though the water level in this room can be changed.
entries.translation: Parece que é possível alterar o nível da água nesta sala.

entries.source: The hanging ropes look like they could support a fair amount of weight.
entries.translation: As cordas penduradas parecem capazes de suportar bastante peso.

entries.source: Several pieces of the wall mechanism are missing.
entries.translation: Faltam várias peças do mecanismo da parede.

entries.source: There must be a way to get past the barriers.
entries.translation: Deve haver uma maneira de passar pelas barreiras.

entries.source: Some of the stone areas look structurally weak.
entries.translation: Algumas partes de pedra parecem estruturalmente frágeis.

entries.source: I've already read this one.
entries.translation: Já li este.

entries.source: There has to be some way across the pit.
entries.translation: Tem que haver um jeito de atravessar o fosso.

entries.source: There appears to be a pattern to the darts.
entries.translation: Parece haver um padrão nos dardos.

entries.source: There appears to be a room on the other side of the crumbled stone wall.
entries.translation: Parece haver uma sala do outro lado da parede de pedra desmoronada.

entries.source: The ruins are in very good condition considering their age.
entries.translation: As ruínas estão muito bem conservadas, considerando a idade.

entries.source: It was you?  You were the Queen of Atlantis.
entries.translation: Foi você? Você era a rainha da Atlântida.

entries.source: Once.
entries.translation: Uma vez.

entries.source: And the Scion holds its history.
entries.translation: E o Scion guarda a história dela.

entries.source: It holds far more than that.  All the knowledge of the Ancients;
entries.translation: Ele guarda muito mais do que isso. Todo o conhecimento dos Antigos;

entries.source: things none of you could even comprehend.
entries.translation: coisas que nenhum de vocês conseguiria sequer compreender.

entries.source: What is the Seventh Age?
entries.translation: O que é a Sétima Era?

entries.source: How far are you willing to go to find out, Lara?
entries.translation: Até onde você está disposta a ir para descobrir, Lara?

entries.source: Not far enough, I'm afraid.
entries.translation: Receio que não o suficiente.

entries.source: Kill her quickly.  We have work to do.
entries.translation: Mate-a depressa. Temos trabalho a fazer.

entries.source: I'm gonna enjoy this.
entries.translation: Vou gostar muito disso.

entries.source: Enjoy watchin'.  I'm cuttin' her.
entries.translation: Aproveite o espetáculo. Estou cortando a garganta dela.

entries.source: There must be a way to get to up to the balcony.
entries.translation: Deve haver uma maneira de chegar à sacada.

entries.source: It appears that some of the stone blocks are moveable.
entries.translation: Parece que alguns blocos de pedra podem ser movidos.

entries.source: The globe doesn't look securely attached to its base.
entries.translation: O globo não parece estar bem preso à base.

entries.source: There must be something in this room that someone was trying to protect.
entries.translation: Deve haver algo nesta sala que alguém estava tentando proteger.

entries.source: The machinery here is broken into pieces.
entries.translation: As máquinas daqui estão em pedaços.

entries.source: The switches probably control some large machinery.
entries.translation: Esses interruptores provavelmente controlam alguma máquina grande.

entries.source: These large columns probably go down beneath the floor.
entries.translation: Essas colunas enormes provavelmente descem até abaixo do piso.

entries.source: There's probably a key somewhere that would help to get to the top of the room.
entries.translation: Deve haver uma chave em algum lugar que ajude a chegar ao alto da sala.

entries.source: Nothing to note here.
entries.translation: Nada de interessante aqui.

entries.source: "And while any number of things can go wrong underground,
entries.translation: E, embora muitas coisas possam dar errado no subsolo,

entries.source: the most dangerous aspect of spelunking is exposure
entries.translation: o aspecto mais perigoso da exploração de cavernas é a exposição

entries.source: to methane gasses which are difficult to detect without specific equipment."
entries.translation: a gases de metano, difíceis de detectar sem equipamento específico.

entries.source: I suppose you're more of a dog person.
entries.translation: Acho que você prefere cachorros.

entries.source: Natla doesn't honor her contracts, Pierre.
entries.translation: Natla não cumpre os contratos, Pierre.

entries.source: I'd move on if I were you.
entries.translation: Eu seguiria em frente, se fosse você.

entries.source: No, mademoiselle, Natla and I understand each other.  I find things for her and she rewards me handsomely.
entries.translation: Não, senhorita. Natla e eu nos entendemos. Encontro coisas para ela, e ela me recompensa muito bem.

entries.source: But you seek the very thing she does.
entries.translation: Mas você está atrás justamente do que ela quer.

entries.source: That is why you are not trusted.
entries.translation: É por isso que não confiam em você.

entries.source: I trust my instincts.
entries.translation: Confio nos meus instintos.

entries.source: And that is why you're in second place.
entries.translation: E é por isso que você está em segundo lugar.

entries.source: I am a professional, mademoiselle.
entries.translation: Sou um profissional, senhorita.

entries.source: I focus on the job, and I get paid.
entries.translation: Concentro-me no trabalho e recebo meu pagamento.

entries.source: There's more to life than money, Pierre.
entries.translation: A vida tem mais do que dinheiro, Pierre.

entries.source: This isn't life, mademoiselle, it's business.
entries.translation: Isto não é vida, senhorita. É negócio.

entries.source: Your compulsion prevents you from seeing the difference.
entries.translation: Sua obsessão impede você de perceber a diferença.

entries.source: It hasn't prevented me from getting a piece of the Scion.  How's business for you?
entries.translation: Ela não me impediu de conseguir um pedaço do Scion. E como vão os negócios para você?

entries.source: Touché.
entries.translation: Touché.

entries.source: So then, why don't we see whose compulsion gets them the next piece.
entries.translation: Então, por que não vemos qual obsessão nos leva à próxima parte?

entries.source: There might be something useful around here.
entries.translation: Talvez haja algo útil por aqui.

entries.source: Father would have loved this.
entries.translation: Meu pai teria adorado isto.

entries.source: There's no need for a fire at this time of day.
entries.translation: Não há necessidade de acender uma fogueira a esta hora do dia.

entries.source: Something's missing.
entries.translation: Está faltando alguma coisa.

entries.source: The archer doesn't seem to have a target.
entries.translation: O arqueiro parece não ter um alvo.

entries.source: This belongs down in the garden. What's it doing in here?
entries.translation: Isto pertence ao jardim. O que está fazendo aqui?

entries.source: There's a strange growth on Natla's back.
entries.translation: Há um crescimento estranho nas costas de Natla.

entries.source: This area is unremarkable.
entries.translation: Esta área não tem nada de especial.

entries.source: "...the ruins of Atlantis were lost beneath the sea
entries.translation: ...as ruínas de Atlântida desapareceram sob o mar

entries.source: when the glaciers melted some ten thousand years ago."
entries.translation: quando as geleiras derreteram, há cerca de dez mil anos.

entries.source: This should make for a shorter return trip.
entries.translation: Assim, o caminho de volta será mais curto.

entries.source: "The concept of the sundial has existed for thousands of years and is one of the earliest devices for time measurement."
entries.translation: O conceito do relógio de sol existe há milhares de anos e é um dos primeiros instrumentos de medição do tempo.

entries.source: There must be a way to open the door above the statue.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de abrir a porta acima da estátua.

entries.source: Some of the pillars are broken away in places.
entries.translation: Alguns pilares estão quebrados em certos pontos.

entries.source: The structures are carved directly from the surrounding rock.
entries.translation: As estruturas foram esculpidas diretamente na rocha ao redor.

entries.source: It looks as though the water level in this room can be changed.
entries.translation: Parece que é possível alterar o nível da água nesta sala.

entries.source: If only there were a platform underneath certain ledges, they'd be within reach.
entries.translation: Se houvesse uma plataforma sob certas saliências, daria para alcançá-las.

entries.source: "Pink is the new black."
entries.translation: Rosa é o novo preto.

entries.source: This area is fairly straightforward.
entries.translation: Esta área é bem simples.

entries.source: There must be a way to open the door.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de abrir a porta.

entries.source: One of the scarab wing counter weights has broken off.
entries.translation: Um dos contrapesos das asas do escaravelho se soltou.

entries.source: Careful exploration of this area may yield favorable results.
entries.translation: Explorar esta área com cuidado pode trazer bons resultados.

entries.source: The inscriptions share characteristics with the writings of many cultures.
entries.translation: As inscrições têm características em comum com escritos de muitas culturas.

entries.source: There's a pattern to these darts.
entries.translation: Há um padrão nesses dardos.

entries.source: There has to be a way out of this room.
entries.translation: Tem que haver uma saída desta sala.

entries.source: The keys don't appear to be anywhere nearby.
entries.translation: As chaves não parecem estar por perto.

entries.source: I do hope Winston will be able to start another fire tonight.
entries.translation: Espero que Winston consiga acender outra fogueira esta noite.

entries.source: The shields appear to reflect the centaur's shots.
entries.translation: Os escudos parecem refletir os disparos do centauro.

entries.source: Perhaps the murals on the stones aren't just for decoration.
entries.translation: Talvez os murais nas pedras não sejam apenas decorativos.

entries.source: The hieroglyphics in the side rooms may hold important information.
entries.translation: Os hieróglifos nas salas laterais podem conter informações importantes.

entries.source: This could come in handy.
entries.translation: Isto pode ser útil.

entries.source: Some of the crates look fragile.
entries.translation: Algumas caixas parecem frágeis.

entries.source: The timing of the gate movement may be important.
entries.translation: O momento em que o portão se move pode ser importante.

entries.source: Some of the supports might be moveable.
entries.translation: Alguns suportes talvez possam ser movidos.

entries.source: A T-Rex tooth might be useful at the temple.
entries.translation: Um dente de T-Rex pode ser útil no templo.

entries.source: I think I'll slip into something else.
entries.translation: Acho que vou trocar de roupa.

entries.source: You have tainted the power of the Scion;
entries.translation: Você corrompeu o poder do Scion;

entries.source: In betraying your fellow Kings
entries.translation: ao trair seus companheiros reis,

entries.source: you have broken the sacred Triumvirate of Atlantis.
entries.translation: você rompeu o sagrado Triunvirato de Atlântida.

entries.source: You have maimed Qualopec.
entries.translation: Você mutilou Qualopec.

entries.source: Your own brother.
entries.translation: Seu próprio irmão.

entries.source: I am still here, wretch.  Tihocan has ended your treachery.
entries.translation: Ainda estou aqui, desgraçado. Tihocan pôs fim à sua traição.

entries.source: But it is my face you will see in your nightmares.
entries.translation: Mas será o meu rosto que você verá nos seus pesadelos.

entries.source: What have you to say for yourself?
entries.translation: O que tem a dizer em sua defesa?

entries.source: There's something special about the hands on that statue.
entries.translation: Há algo especial nas mãos daquela estátua.

entries.source: There must be a way to rotate the latches.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de girar as travas.

entries.source: There are symbols above the door.
entries.translation: Há símbolos acima da porta.

entries.source: Such beauty.
entries.translation: Que beleza.

entries.source: There's something special about the orientation of the hieroglyphs.
entries.translation: Há algo especial na orientação dos hieróglifos.

entries.source: The artifacts in the obelisk look to have some significance.
entries.translation: Os artefatos no obelisco parecem ter algum significado.

entries.source: The sundial isn't displaying the correct time.
entries.translation: O relógio de sol não está marcando a hora certa.

entries.source: Finally, I'll be able to take that hot shower.
entries.translation: Finalmente vou poder tomar aquele banho quente.

entries.source: "...by far the most intriguing is the legend surrounding the fabled dagger of
entries.translation: ...de longe, o mais intrigante é a lenda em torno do lendário punhal de

entries.source: Xi'an and the awesome power it wields."
entries.translation: Xi’an e do poder impressionante que ele possui.

entries.source: The inscriptions on the walls indicate an advanced culture existed here.
entries.translation: As inscrições nas paredes indicam que existiu aqui uma cultura avançada.

entries.source: The structure in the center of the room looks like it can be rotated.
entries.translation: A estrutura no centro da sala parece poder girar.

entries.source: The constellation patterns might be important.
entries.translation: Os padrões das constelações podem ser importantes.

entries.source: The base of the center column doesn't look very sturdy.
entries.translation: A base da coluna central não parece muito firme.

entries.source: I should probably push on.
entries.translation: É melhor eu seguir em frente.

entries.source: The best way out of here may be to climb up.
entries.translation: Talvez o melhor caminho para sair daqui seja subir.

entries.source: "When Lord Byron gave the Bridge of Sighs its name in the 19th century,
entries.translation: Quando Lord Byron deu esse nome à Ponte dos Suspiros no século XIX,

entries.source: he imagined what it must have been like for a prisoner
entries.translation: imaginou como seria para um prisioneiro

entries.source: to take one final look at the beauty of Venice,
entries.translation: olhar uma última vez para a beleza de Veneza

entries.source: before being led to their fate in the prison below."
entries.translation: antes de ser levado ao destino na prisão abaixo.

entries.source: There must be a way to open the door.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de abrir a porta.

entries.source: Now all I need is something to shoot.
entries.translation: Agora só preciso de algo para atirar.

entries.source: What a lovely tune.
entries.translation: Que melodia adorável.

entries.source: "The native population of Costa Rica was ravaged by diseases brought by it's conquerors
entries.translation: A população nativa da Costa Rica foi devastada pelas doenças trazidas por seus conquistadores

entries.source: and barely managed to survive to see the establishment of a capital city."
entries.translation: e mal conseguiu sobreviver até a fundação de uma capital.

entries.source: Deadly traps seemed to have been these people's specialty.
entries.translation: As armadilhas mortais pareciam ser a especialidade desse povo.

entries.source: The door has a musical lock.
entries.translation: A porta tem uma fechadura musical.

entries.source: There must be a way to raise this gate.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de levantar este portão.

entries.source: This place was built by an advanced culture.
entries.translation: Este lugar foi construído por uma cultura avançada.

entries.source: Perhaps the carvings on the stones aren't just for decoration.
entries.translation: Talvez as esculturas nas pedras não sejam apenas decorativas.

entries.source: There must be a way into that temple.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de entrar naquele templo.

entries.source: I thought I'd lost this.
entries.translation: Achei que tivesse perdido isto.

entries.source: The stone pillars look structurally weak.
entries.translation: Os pilares de pedra parecem estruturalmente frágeis.

entries.source: The control room must be accessible somehow.
entries.translation: Deve haver algum jeito de acessar a sala de controle.

entries.source: Hmmm...interesting.
entries.translation: Hmm... interessante.

entries.source: The door under the sphinx requires two Ankh shaped keys to open.
entries.translation: A porta sob a esfinge precisa de duas chaves em forma de Ankh para abrir.

entries.source: These caves warrant careful exploration.
entries.translation: Estas cavernas merecem ser exploradas com cuidado.

entries.source: The creature's limbs are misshapen. One could be weaker than the other.
entries.translation: Os membros da criatura são deformados. Talvez um deles seja mais fraco que o outro.

entries.source: The crates are very heavy.
entries.translation: As caixas são muito pesadas.

entries.source: Natla exposes her back after certain attacks.
entries.translation: Natla deixa as costas expostas depois de certos ataques.

entries.source: The central sculpture appears to be missing some pieces.
entries.translation: Parece que faltam algumas peças na escultura central.

entries.source: There are multiple ways to tackle an obstacle course.
entries.translation: Há várias maneiras de encarar uma pista de obstáculos.

entries.source: That's better.
entries.translation: Assim está melhor.

entries.source: Some parts of the wall look more mechanical than decorative.
entries.translation: Algumas partes da parede parecem mais mecânicas do que decorativas.

entries.source: "As he struggled mightily to calm himself,
entries.translation: Enquanto se esforçava para se acalmar,

entries.source: Gilead removed the poison ARROW from its quiver."
entries.translation: Gilead tirou a FLECHA envenenada da aljava.

entries.source: --The Trials of Gilead, Volume II.
entries.translation: --As provações de Gilead, Volume II.

entries.source: "With the Silk Road bringing thousands of travelers into the region annually,
entries.translation: Com a Rota da Seda trazendo milhares de viajantes à região todos os anos,

entries.source: Delhi was soon overrun by merchants selling goods of every possible description."
entries.translation: Delhi logo ficou tomada por comerciantes que vendiam todo tipo de mercadoria.

entries.source: There appears to be something missing from the panels near the statue.
entries.translation: Parece que falta algo nos painéis perto da estátua.

entries.source: The statues guarding the temple look almost too real.
entries.translation: As estátuas que guardam o templo parecem reais demais.

entries.source: The door locks move back into place rather slowly.
entries.translation: As travas da porta voltam ao lugar bem devagar.

entries.source: I wish I hadn't had to do that.
entries.translation: Queria não ter precisado fazer isso.

entries.source: The floating pieces might fit together somehow.
entries.translation: Talvez seja possível encaixar as peças flutuantes.

entries.source: "And there he stood, assuring all within earshot of his coming victory
entries.translation: E lá estava ele, garantindo a todos que o ouviam que venceria,

entries.source: until it was time to return to his ships. Leaving Athens to undertake his mighty task."
entries.translation: até chegar a hora de voltar aos navios e deixar Atenas para cumprir sua grande missão.

entries.source: Vilcabamba continues to elude us,
entries.translation: Vilcabamba continua fora do nosso alcance,

entries.source: and my insistence that we press on
entries.translation: e minha insistência para que avancemos

entries.source: in spite of these failures has morale low...
entries.translation: apesar desses fracassos está desanimando a equipe...

entries.source: I suspect Jenkins to be the author of this sedition;
entries.translation: Suspeito que Jenkins seja o autor desta conspiração;

entries.source: he simply refuses to accept the possibility that Atlantis is the foundation
entries.translation: ele simplesmente se recusa a aceitar a possibilidade de que Atlântida seja o alicerce

entries.source: upon which all known civilizations were built.
entries.translation: sobre o qual todas as civilizações conhecidas foram construídas.

entries.source: Increasingly, I find it is Lara alone
entries.translation: Cada vez mais, percebo que só Lara

entries.source: who remains untainted by academic dogma
entries.translation: permanece livre do dogmatismo acadêmico

entries.source: and open-minded enough to see this truth.
entries.translation: e tem a mente aberta o bastante para enxergar esta verdade.

entries.source: I'm sorry; I didn't bring enough rope.
entries.translation: Desculpe; não trouxe corda suficiente.

entries.source: Not to worry.  I'll find another way up.
entries.translation: Não se preocupe. Vou encontrar outro caminho para subir.

entries.source: Something about this place doesn't feel right.
entries.translation: Há algo neste lugar que não me parece certo.

entries.source: The loose planks under the stairs may be obscuring something.
entries.translation: As tábuas soltas sob a escada podem estar escondendo alguma coisa.

entries.source: There's some numbers written on the inside cover. 11 2 7.  I wonder what they refer to?
entries.translation: Há alguns números escritos na contracapa: 11 2 7. O que será que significam?

entries.source: This just proves time never stands still.
entries.translation: Isto só prova que o tempo nunca para.

entries.source: This was quite a challenge to retrieve.
entries.translation: Foi um desafio e tanto recuperar isto.

entries.source: The sundial appears to be missing a critical piece.
entries.translation: Parece que falta uma peça essencial no relógio de sol.

entries.source: There must be a way to lower the drawbridges.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de baixar as pontes levadiças.

entries.source: The water doesn't seem to be flowing at full capacity.
entries.translation: A água parece não estar correndo com força total.

entries.source: Some of these objects may float.
entries.translation: Alguns destes objetos talvez flutuem.

entries.source: There's a hole above the gate.
entries.translation: Há um buraco acima do portão.

entries.source: "Anyone with even a cursory knowledge of mineralogy would arrive at the same conclusion.
entries.translation: Qualquer pessoa com um conhecimento básico de mineralogia chegaria à mesma conclusão.

entries.source: Wherever this Isis stone was formed, it wasn't on Earth."
entries.translation: Onde quer que esta pedra de Ísis tenha se formado, não foi na Terra.

entries.source: I've never been fond of locked doors.
entries.translation: Nunca gostei de portas trancadas.

entries.source: The door is locked.
entries.translation: A porta está trancada.

entries.source: The mechanism on the wall seems to be connected to the waterfall.
entries.translation: O mecanismo na parede parece estar ligado à cachoeira.

entries.source: There may be something of interest under the water.
entries.translation: Pode haver algo interessante debaixo d’água.

entries.source: It's probably wise to look around.
entries.translation: É melhor dar uma olhada ao redor.

entries.source: The obelisks look ready to fall apart.
entries.translation: Os obeliscos parecem prestes a desmoronar.

entries.source: This book's not very interesting.
entries.translation: Este livro não é muito interessante.

entries.source: Ah, yes.
entries.translation: Ah, sim.

entries.source: There must be a way to get the energy to flow from the switch to the door.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de fazer a energia fluir do interruptor até a porta.

entries.source: There may be a way to disable some of the traps.
entries.translation: Talvez seja possível desativar algumas armadilhas.

entries.source: "The roots of the banyan tree grow relentlessly and in every direction.
entries.translation: As raízes da figueira-de-bengala crescem sem parar e em todas as direções.

entries.source: Many of the ancient temples of Angkor have been brought down
entries.translation: Muitos templos antigos de Angkor desabaram

entries.source: as those roots exploit the small spaces between their massive stones."
entries.translation: porque essas raízes se infiltraram nas pequenas frestas entre as enormes pedras.

entries.source: There may be places to climb on the large statues.
entries.translation: Talvez seja possível escalar as estátuas grandes.

entries.source: Better pick up the pace!
entries.translation: É melhor acelerar!

entries.source: What's a man got to do to get that sort of attention from you?
entries.translation: O que um homem precisa fazer para receber esse tipo de atenção sua?

entries.source: If that's the sort of attention you want, Larson, you're well on your way.
entries.translation: Se é esse tipo de atenção que você quer, Larson, está no caminho certo.

entries.source: Sounds like fun, but I'm only here to make an introduction.
entries.translation: Parece divertido, mas só vim fazer as apresentações.

entries.source: Lara Croft, meet Jacqueline Natla, of Natla Technologies.
entries.translation: Lara Croft, conheça Jacqueline Natla, da Natla Technologies.

entries.source: Good afternoon, Miss Croft.
entries.translation: Boa tarde, senhorita Croft.

entries.source: My research department has recently turned its focus to the study of ancient artifacts.
entries.translation: Meu departamento de pesquisa começou recentemente a estudar artefatos antigos.

entries.source: And I'm led to believe that, with the right incentive,
entries.translation: E me disseram que, com o incentivo certo,

entries.source: you're just the woman to find them for me.
entries.translation: você é a pessoa ideal para encontrá-los para mim.

entries.source: I'm afraid you've been misled.  I only play for sport.
entries.translation: Receio que tenham informado você errado. Só faço isso por esporte.

entries.source: Which is precisely why I've come to you, Miss Croft.
entries.translation: E é justamente por isso que procurei você, senhorita Croft.

entries.source: This is a game you've played before; with your Father.
entries.translation: Você já participou deste jogo antes, com seu pai.

entries.source: You both spent years searching for the Scion of Atlantis.
entries.translation: Vocês passaram anos procurando o Scion de Atlântida.

entries.source: All you needed was the location of Qualopec's Tomb.
entries.translation: Só precisavam descobrir onde ficava a tumba de Qualopec.

entries.source: You've found Vilcabamba?
entries.translation: Você encontrou Vilcabamba?

entries.source: How quickly can you get to Peru?
entries.translation: Quanto tempo levaria para chegar ao Peru?

entries.source: There are multiple connections between this room and the next.
entries.translation: Há várias passagens entre esta sala e a próxima.

entries.source: It appears that four keys are needed to open the large door at the bottom of this room.
entries.translation: Parece que são necessárias quatro chaves para abrir a porta grande no fundo desta sala.

entries.source: The movement of the scarab seems to be blocked by something.
entries.translation: Parece que algo está bloqueando o movimento do escaravelho.

entries.source: "It is only through knowing our history that we can learn from the past."
entries.translation: Só conhecendo nossa história podemos aprender com o passado.

entries.source: It looks as if Pierre has come this way.
entries.translation: Parece que Pierre passou por aqui.

entries.source: Here lies the God-King Tihocan; One of the Triumvirate; Keepers of the Three Pieces of the Scion;
entries.translation: Aqui jaz o deus-rei Tihocan; um dos membros do Triunvirato, guardião das Três Partes do Scion;

entries.source: Leader of the chosen after the great betrayal
entries.translation: líder dos escolhidos depois que a grande traição

entries.source: caused Atlantis to be lost beneath the waves
entries.translation: fez Atlântida desaparecer sob as ondas.

entries.source: You see?  Instincts can be expensive, mademoiselle.
entries.translation: Viu? Seguir os instintos pode sair caro, senhorita.

entries.source: Yours are going to cost you both pieces of the Scion.
entries.translation: Os seus vão custar as duas partes do Scion.

entries.source: That's not a price I'm prepared to pay.
entries.translation: Não estou disposta a pagar esse preço.

entries.source: Don't be absurd.  No job is worth dying for.
entries.translation: Não seja absurda. Nenhum trabalho vale a própria vida.

entries.source: Yes.  It is.
entries.translation: Este vale.

entries.source: There might be something useful in the crates.
entries.translation: Talvez haja algo útil nas caixas.

entries.source: The door might work similarly to the earlier one.
entries.translation: A porta talvez funcione como a anterior.

entries.source: The fingers on the creature appear to be a weak point.
entries.translation: Os dedos da criatura parecem ser um ponto fraco.

entries.source: The pharaoh statues look like they might slide.
entries.translation: Parece que as estátuas dos faraós podem deslizar.

entries.source: There must be a way up to the higher areas.
entries.translation: Deve haver um caminho para as áreas mais altas.

entries.source: The structure protruding from the ceiling may be linked to the door.
entries.translation: A estrutura que sai do teto talvez esteja ligada à porta.

entries.source: There are signs that the people here were quite advanced.
entries.translation: Há sinais de que este povo era bastante avançado.

entries.source: "When the Spaniards had all but wiped out the Incan empire,
entries.translation: Quando os espanhóis praticamente já haviam destruído o império inca,

entries.source: the remaining survivors fled to the mountains and disappeared.
entries.translation: os poucos sobreviventes restantes fugiram para as montanhas e desapareceram.

entries.source: Legends say they retreated to the hidden city of Vilcabamba."
entries.translation: As lendas dizem que se refugiaram na cidade escondida de Vilcabamba.

entries.source: This should help getting into those hard-to-reach places.
entries.translation: Isto deve ajudar a chegar aos lugares mais difíceis.

entries.source: There might be some significance to the light coming out of the obelisk.
entries.translation: Talvez haja algum significado na luz que sai do obelisco.

entries.source: There's something in the hands of this sculpture.
entries.translation: Há algo nas mãos desta escultura.

entries.source: There must be a way up to the higher areas.
entries.translation: Deve haver um caminho para as áreas mais altas.

entries.source: Perhaps there is a way to make a path to the other doors.
entries.translation: Talvez exista um jeito de abrir caminho até as outras portas.

entries.source: There has to be a safe way across the lava.
entries.translation: Tem que haver um caminho seguro sobre a lava.

entries.source: The drill car may still be functional.
entries.translation: O veículo de perfuração talvez ainda funcione.

entries.source: The temple may provide some cover.
entries.translation: O templo pode servir de abrigo.

entries.source: Lovely.
entries.translation: Que beleza.

entries.source: Sometimes keys aren't keys at all.
entries.translation: Às vezes, uma chave não é bem uma chave.

entries.source: "While other traps have a similar closing mechanism,
entries.translation: Embora outras armadilhas usem um mecanismo de fechamento parecido,

entries.source: it was the Egyptians who perfected the savage effectiveness of the holding barbs."
entries.translation: foram os egípcios que aperfeiçoaram a eficácia brutal das farpas de retenção.

entries.source: No wonder Father never got lost.
entries.translation: Não é à toa que meu pai nunca se perdia.

entries.source: Perhaps the orientation of the obelisks is important.
entries.translation: Talvez a orientação dos obeliscos seja importante.

entries.source: The rope looks weak.
entries.translation: A corda parece fraca.

entries.source: The centaur's shields are quite effective at blocking my shots.
entries.translation: Os escudos do centauro são muito eficazes para bloquear meus disparos.

entries.source: I wonder if Winston read any of it?
entries.translation: Será que Winston leu alguma coisa disso?

entries.source: It's rather hot.
entries.translation: Está bem quente.

entries.source: What have you really accomplished here?
entries.translation: O que você realmente conseguiu aqui?

entries.source: Nothing but a temporary stay of execution for your kind.
entries.translation: Apenas adiar por um tempo a execução da sua espécie.

entries.source: This island is just one remnant of Atlantis; I will find another.
entries.translation: Esta ilha é só um vestígio de Atlântida; encontrarei outro.

entries.source: But you, Lara.  You have lost everything.
entries.translation: Mas você, Lara, perdeu tudo.

entries.source: No, I haven't.
entries.translation: Não, não perdi.

entries.source: There may be some significance to the pictures on the floor.
entries.translation: Talvez as imagens no chão tenham algum significado.

entries.source: There's light coming from under the door.
entries.translation: Há luz saindo debaixo da porta.

entries.source: Perhaps the murals around the room aren't just for decoration.
entries.translation: Talvez os murais ao redor da sala não sejam apenas decorativos.

entries.source: There must be a way to access the upper areas of this room.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de acessar as áreas mais altas desta sala.

entries.source: There's something underneath the grate on the bottom of the room.
entries.translation: Há algo sob a grade no fundo da sala.

entries.source: I'd love to join you, but I forgot my trunks.
entries.translation: Eu adoraria ir com você, mas esqueci minha sunga.

entries.source: Why am I not surprised?
entries.translation: Por que será que não estou surpresa?

entries.source: You've got your job; I've got mine.  I'll take it from here.
entries.translation: Você tem o seu trabalho; eu tenho o meu. Deixa comigo.

entries.source: I hope Natla sent you here with more than that shotgun.
entries.translation: Espero que Natla tenha mandado você para cá com algo além dessa escopeta.

entries.source: Don't sweat it, kitten; I prefer a more hands-on approach.
entries.translation: Relaxa, gatinha; prefiro resolver as coisas de perto.

entries.source: Here sits the God-King Qualopec;
entries.translation: Aqui jaz o deus-rei Qualopec;

entries.source: One of the Triumvirate; Keepers of the Three pieces of the Scion;
entries.translation: um dos membros do Triunvirato, guardião das Três Partes do Scion;

entries.source: Diviners of its knowledge; Sacred rulers of Atlantis.
entries.translation: intérprete de seu conhecimento; governante sagrado de Atlântida.

entries.source: Exquisite.
entries.translation: Magnífico.

entries.source: Talk about being your own worst enemy.
entries.translation: Isso sim é ser seu pior inimigo.

entries.source: The falling swords seem to be triggered by movement.
entries.translation: As espadas que caem parecem ser acionadas pelo movimento.

entries.source: There must be some way into that smaller structure.
entries.translation: Deve haver algum jeito de entrar naquela estrutura menor.

entries.source: An uncomplicated room.
entries.translation: Uma sala sem complicações.

entries.source: There must be a switch somewhere to open the other gate.
entries.translation: Deve haver um interruptor em algum lugar para abrir o outro portão.

entries.source: "The legend tells us that the kings of Tibet were descendents
entries.translation: Diz a lenda que os reis do Tibete eram descendentes

entries.source: from heaven with ropes attaching them to heaven itself.
entries.translation: do céu, presos a ele por cordas.

entries.source: When they died, a heavenly creature would pull the ropes up,
entries.translation: Quando morriam, uma criatura celestial puxava as cordas para cima.

entries.source: There must be a passageway out of this area somewhere.
entries.translation: Deve haver uma passagem para fora desta área em algum lugar.

entries.source: The water into this cave is being diverted by that sculpture.
entries.translation: Aquela escultura está desviando a água que entra nesta caverna.

entries.source: There may be a higher path in this area.
entries.translation: Talvez haja um caminho mais alto nesta área.

entries.source: The plates on the floor need something very heavy to hold them down.
entries.translation: É preciso algo muito pesado para manter as placas do chão pressionadas.

entries.source: There may be a higher path in this area.
entries.translation: Talvez haja um caminho mais alto nesta área.

entries.source: "Better still, the new 50 caliber round comes with a full metal jacket
entries.translation: Melhor ainda: o novo cartucho calibre .50 vem com jaqueta metálica completa

entries.source: designed to maximize muzzle velocity and power to the target."
entries.translation: projetada para maximizar a velocidade na saída do cano e a potência no alvo.

entries.source: There are multiple connections between this room and the previous one.
entries.translation: Há várias passagens entre esta sala e a anterior.

entries.source: The Greeks had an affinity for heavenly bodies.
entries.translation: Os gregos tinham afinidade com os corpos celestes.

entries.source: There appears to be a passage behind the waterfall.
entries.translation: Parece haver uma passagem atrás da cachoeira.

entries.source: King Midas was known for having the "golden touch".
entries.translation: O rei Midas era conhecido pelo seu “toque de ouro”.

entries.source: This cave looks like it might have several passages to explore.
entries.translation: Esta caverna parece ter várias passagens para explorar.

entries.source: The door is connected to a large mechanism.
entries.translation: A porta está ligada a um mecanismo grande.

entries.source: The room spirals up to the top floor.
entries.translation: A sala sobe em espiral até o último andar.

entries.source: "...And even as their hooves shook the earth beneath him,
entries.translation: E mesmo com os cascos sacudindo a terra sob seus pés,

entries.source: Gilead gathered his remaining strength and drew back his BOW."
entries.translation: Gilead reuniu as forças que lhe restavam e retesou o ARCO.

entries.source: --The Trials of Gilead, Volume I
entries.translation: --As provações de Gilead, Volume I

entries.source: Medusa was a frightful creature in Greek mythology.
entries.translation: Medusa era uma criatura terrível da mitologia grega.

entries.source: I suppose I'll have to order another statue.
entries.translation: Acho que vou ter que encomendar outra estátua.

entries.source: Those circular plates look as though they might activate something.
entries.translation: Essas placas circulares parecem ativar alguma coisa.

entries.source: The furniture looks oddly arranged.
entries.translation: Os móveis estão dispostos de um jeito estranho.

entries.source: This place is structurally unsound.
entries.translation: Este lugar está estruturalmente comprometido.

entries.source: Perhaps a combined effort is required.
entries.translation: Talvez seja preciso agir em conjunto.

entries.source: There must be a way to open the door.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de abrir a porta.

entries.source: I'm glad this didn't get damaged.
entries.translation: Ainda bem que isto não foi danificado.

entries.source: There is light coming from above the altar.
entries.translation: Há luz saindo de cima do altar.

entries.source: The orientation of the scarabs might be important.
entries.translation: A orientação dos escaravelhos pode ser importante.

entries.source: Some switches can only be reached if they're underwater.
entries.translation: Só é possível alcançar alguns interruptores debaixo d’água.

entries.source: There must be a way to access the upper area of this room.
entries.translation: Deve haver um jeito de acessar a parte superior desta sala.

entries.source: Some of the wall pillars look structurally weak.
entries.translation: Alguns pilares da parede parecem estruturalmente frágeis.

entries.source: There's a switch on the other side of the bars.
entries.translation: Há um interruptor do outro lado das grades.

entries.source: "Prolific evidence exists that the ancient Eskimos would carve
entries.translation: Há muitas evidências de que os antigos esquimós esculpiam

entries.source: extremely detailed ivory maps of their coastline and hunting waters."
entries.translation: mapas de marfim extremamente detalhados de seu litoral e de suas áreas de caça.

entries.source: No sign of the Scion here.
entries.translation: Nenhum sinal do Scion por aqui.

entries.source: The pods on the walls contain strange creatures.
entries.translation: Os casulos nas paredes contêm criaturas estranhas.

entries.source: I've read all of these.
entries.translation: Já li todos estes.

entries.source: Looks like our girl's pulled it off.
entries.translation: Parece que nossa garota conseguiu.

entries.source: Of course she has.  Now it's up to you.
entries.translation: Claro que sim. Agora é com você.

entries.source: Not that I'm complaining boss, but what makes you so sure
entries.translation: Não que eu esteja reclamando, chefe, mas por que tem tanta certeza

entries.source: she's not going to bring it back herself?
entries.translation: de que ela não vai trazer o Scion de volta pessoalmente?

entries.source: Lara would never part with the Scion; she's far too obsessed with it.
entries.translation: Lara jamais abriria mão do Scion; é obcecada demais por ele.

entries.source: Just like her father.
entries.translation: Igual ao pai.

entries.source: Ah, Monsieur Dupont, you have something to report?
entries.translation: Ah, Monsieur Dupont, tem alguma notícia?

entries.source: Good news, Madame, your information was correct.
entries.translation: Boas notícias, Madame. Sua informação estava correta.

entries.source: I have located my piece of the Scion.
entries.translation: Encontrei a minha parte do Scion.

entries.source: Voilà.  It is buried under a place called
entries.translation: Voilà. Está enterrada num lugar chamado

entries.source: St. Francis Folly.
entries.translation: Insensatez de São Francisco.

entries.source: The surface of that pyramid warrants a closer look.  It would be useful to find a way up there.
entries.translation: Vale a pena examinar melhor a superfície da pirâmide. Seria bom encontrar um jeito de subir até lá.

entries.source: There appears to be a room behind the one statue base.
entries.translation: Parece haver uma sala atrás da base da estátua.

entries.source: On second thought, you have it!
entries.translation: Pensando bem, fique com ele!

entries.source: Bonne chance!
entries.translation: Bonne chance!

entries.source: There may be significance to the symbols above that door.
entries.translation: Talvez os símbolos acima daquela porta tenham algum significado.

entries.source: "The luxury liner Maria Doria has never been found,
entries.translation: O transatlântico de luxo Maria Doria nunca foi encontrado,

entries.source: however treasure hunters the world over search endlessly for its resting place."
entries.translation: mas caçadores de tesouros do mundo inteiro continuam procurando seu local de repouso.

entries.source: Don't worry, Lara.  The water is quite refreshing.  Ha-Ha
entries.translation: Não se preocupe, Lara. A água está bem refrescante. Ha-ha.

entries.source: The switch on the wall looks important.
entries.translation: O interruptor na parede parece importante.

entries.source: But it is my face you will see in your nightmares.
entries.translation: Mas será o meu rosto que você verá nos seus pesadelos.

entries.source: What have you to say for yourself?
entries.translation: O que tem a dizer em sua defesa?

entries.source: The Gods favor action, not council.
entries.translation: Os deuses favorecem a ação, não os conselhos.

entries.source: Yet it is this council that rules over you today.
entries.translation: Mas hoje é esse conselho que governa vocês.

entries.source: You rule over nothing!
entries.translation: Você não governa nada!

entries.source: Atlantis is in ruin; nothing can change that.
entries.translation: Atlântida está em ruínas; nada pode mudar isso.

entries.source: Everything must burn.
entries.translation: Tudo precisa arder.

entries.source: Only then can the Seventh Age begin.
entries.translation: Só então poderá começar a Sétima Era.

entries.source: You choose a path to madness.  I wash my hands of you.
entries.translation: Você escolheu o caminho da loucura. Não quero mais saber.

entries.source: For your treachery;
entries.translation: Por sua traição;

entries.source: for using the knowledge of the Scion
entries.translation: por usar o conhecimento do Scion

entries.source: to unleash our armies against us,
entries.translation: para lançar nossos exércitos contra nós,

entries.source: I expel you forever from the sacred order of The Three,
entries.translation: eu expulso você para sempre da sagrada ordem dos Três

entries.source: and condemn you to shame in the frozen limbo of eternity.
entries.translation: e o condeno à vergonha no limbo congelado da eternidade.

entries.source: ok sabthin, fik neprent...
entries.translation: ok sabthin, fik neprent...

entries.source: It cannot be stopped!
entries.translation: Não pode ser detido!

entries.source: The wheels of Kathar are already in motion!
entries.translation: As rodas de Kathar já estão em movimento!

entries.source: Nam sing praten
entries.translation: Nam sing praten

entries.source: Doom will find you both while I rise
entries.translation: A desgraça encontrará vocês dois enquanto eu me ergo

entries.source: Rauf te nang
entries.translation: Rauf te nang

entries.source: from the dust of your bones to finish what I've started-
entries.translation: da poeira dos seus ossos para terminar o que comecei-

entries.source: So tan qua lua licheon!
entries.translation: So tan qua lua licheon!

entries.source: There may be a way to lure the T-Rex into hurting himself.
entries.translation: Talvez seja possível fazer o T-Rex se machucar sozinho.

entries.source: The drill car will require a key.
entries.translation: O veículo de perfuração precisa de uma chave.

entries.source: Miss Croft, Pardon the mess in the foyer,
entries.translation: Senhorita Croft, perdoe a bagunça no saguão,

entries.source: but a rather large shipment of antiquities arrived while you were out.
entries.translation: mas chegou uma remessa bem grande de antiguidades enquanto a senhorita estava fora.

entries.source: I would have had the crates placed in the Gallery,
entries.translation: Eu teria mandado colocar as caixas na galeria,

entries.source: but the security alarm has somehow been activated,
entries.translation: mas o alarme de segurança foi acionado de algum modo

entries.source: locking the room from the inside.
entries.translation: e trancou a sala por dentro.

entries.source: If this was not concerning enough,
entries.translation: Como se isso já não fosse preocupante o bastante,

entries.source: the renovators have shut off the water supply to the entire manor
entries.translation: os responsáveis pela reforma interromperam o fornecimento de água de toda a mansão

entries.source: in order to continue construction of the pool house.
entries.translation: para continuar a construção da casa da piscina.

entries.source: On the bright side, I've located your missing journal and
entries.translation: Pelo lado bom, encontrei seu diário desaparecido e

entries.source: returned it to its appointed hiding place in your room.
entries.translation: o devolvi ao esconderijo de sempre no seu quarto.

entries.source: Faithfully in your service, Winston.
entries.translation: Sempre a seu serviço, Winston.

entries.source: I cannot die, you fool.
entries.translation: Não posso morrer, seu tolo.

entries.source: Sooner or later, you'll run out of bullets.
entries.translation: Mais cedo ou mais tarde, sua munição vai acabar.

entries.source: Splendid.
entries.translation: Excelente.

entries.source: There may be a way to get the creature to fall off the platform.
entries.translation: Talvez haja um jeito de fazer a criatura cair da plataforma.

entries.source: What a delightfully gruesome display.
entries.translation: Que espetáculo deliciosamente macabro.

entries.source: The room has entrances and exits at both the top and the bottom.
entries.translation: A sala tem entradas e saídas tanto em cima quanto embaixo.

entries.source: There's something different about this room.
entries.translation: Há algo diferente nesta sala.

entries.source: Many of the ancient structures have fallen into ruin.
entries.translation: Muitas das estruturas antigas estão em ruínas.

entries.source: "It was here in the sixth century BC, between the Aventine
entries.translation: Foi aqui, no século VI a.C., entre as colinas do Aventino

entries.source: and the Palatine hills, that the Circus Maximus was born."
entries.translation: e do Palatino, que nasceu o Circo Máximo.

entries.source: Natla's wings appear to be weakened from her fall into the lava.
entries.translation: As asas de Natla parecem enfraquecidas depois da queda na lava.

entries.source: A wrench would turn the valves well enough.
entries.translation: Uma chave inglesa serviria para girar as válvulas.

entries.source: I wonder where this goes?
entries.translation: Para onde será que isto vai?

entries.source: These columns may move up and down.
entries.translation: Estas colunas talvez subam e desçam.

entries.source: That drawbridge looks very unstable.
entries.translation: Aquela ponte levadiça parece muito instável.

entries.source: This is only one piece of the Scion; Where's the rest of it?
entries.translation: Este é apenas um pedaço do Scion. Onde está o resto?

entries.source: Gimme a minute, I'm thinking.
entries.translation: Me dá um minuto, estou pensando.

entries.source: Whoa!  It makes no difference to me:
entries.translation: Uau! Para mim, tanto faz:

entries.source: Pierre's probably already found his piece.
entries.translation: Pierre provavelmente já encontrou a parte dele.

entries.source: Pierre Dupont?  Where?
entries.translation: Pierre Dupont? Onde?

entries.source: Now that  I don't know.
entries.translation: Isso eu já não sei.

entries.source: All right.  I'm convinced.
entries.translation: Tudo bem. Estou convencida.

entries.source: Damn, you really had me going there.
entries.translation: Droga, você me enganou direitinho.

entries.source: A stunning addition to my collection.
entries.translation: Uma adição impressionante à minha coleção.

entries.source: The center column seems to be holding up the weight of the entire ceiling.
entries.translation: Parece que a coluna central sustenta o peso do teto inteiro.

entries.source: Nothing of importance here.
entries.translation: Nada importante aqui.

entries.source: "By far the most important survival item one can possibly have
entries.translation: De longe, o item de sobrevivência mais importante que alguém pode ter

entries.translation: é a vontade de sobreviver.
